sources.snippet: Credit. Samosa Chat is built on colibrì by JustVugg. Its expert-streaming design, SIMD kernels, and core utility headers made this project possible. The model is the text part of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, created and released by the Qwen team. Samosa Chat is an independent, unofficial, Apache-2.0 project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by either team.
